proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: First time in a dispensary since it became legal. Nobody rushed me. She showed me three jars, explained what the numbers on the label meant, and told me to start with half a piece. I left feeling like I knew what I bought.
reviews.name: Gail R.

reviews.text: Snowed in up at Kachina Village, ordered online at noon, drove down when the plows came through. Texted from the lot and the bag was at my window in about two minutes.
reviews.name: Tomas E.

reviews.text: We were on our way to the canyon with Ohio licenses and weren't sure it would work. ID scan took seconds. The guy at the counter also reminded us not to bring anything into the park, which was good to know.
reviews.name: Brenda K.

reviews.text: I like that they open the jar in front of you and put it on the scale where you can read it. Small thing, but I've been shorted elsewhere.
reviews.name: Ruben A.

reviews.text: Asked about edibles because the last ones I tried were way too much. He pointed at the milligrams per piece, cut the suggestion in half, and wrote the timing on the receipt. Calm, no eye-rolling.
reviews.name: Ellen M.

reviews.text: Quick stop after work most Fridays. The pre-order is always packed when I get there and the wait at the counter is short even at six.
reviews.name: Jaren W.

proof.guarantee: A cartridge that will not fire gets swapped within 14 days, with your receipt.
